correctness.rationale: Main existence claim M(12,20)>=1.0 via explicit S* verified exactly by independent re-execution. Provided verifier on provided coordinates outputs n=20 total_triples=1140 D=2 A=1.0 n0=0 n1=0 c2=34 c3=42 PASS in 0.014s (reproduced by auditor). Auditor wrote two additional independent code paths: (i) matrix-determinant form qx*(ry-py)+rx*(py-qy)+px*(qy-ry) over all C(20,3)=1140 triples gives min 2, n0=0, n1=0, c2=34, c3=42; (ii) shoelace difference form gives identical histogram prefix 2:34, 3:42, 4:36, 5:4, 6:44, 7:10, 8:38, 9:18, 10:46. Range check: all 20 points in {0..11}^2, 20 distinct, no duplicates. Hence no three collinear (D=0 absent) and no unimodular/area-0.5 triple (D=1 absent); D(S*)=2, A=1.0 proved by exhaustive integer enumeration, no floats, deterministic. Secondary claim H(S*)=6 verified independently: witness W={(0,1),(0,3),(1,7),(2,3),(3,6),(3,9)} has monotone-chain hull size 6 (strictly convex) and zero S*-points strictly inside conv(W) under exact sign-of-det predicates; exhaustive search over C(20,7)=77520 7-subsets finds zero empty-convex 7-sets (0.3s), and alternative angular-sort convexity test over C(20,8) finds zero empty-convex 8-sets, so by monotonicity (any empty convex k>7 contains an empty convex 7-subset, since subsets of strictly convex position sets are strictly convex and conv(subset) subset conv(parent)) H<=6, hence H=6. This closes the dependence on unprovided scratch/hcalc.py. Search-method description is honest stochastic existence proof with explicit disclaimers (no optimality, gaps are best-found not impossibility, D>=3 open); no proof/experiment conflation. One non-material presentation imprecision noted: DRAFT section 3 tail histogram beyond det=10 lists 11:15, 12:53(? from seed-6 set), max 109-scale, whereas exact full histogram is 11:8, 12:26, max 100 (full table verified by auditor). The decisive bins (D, n0, n1, c2, c3, prefix to 10) are all correct and the uncertain tail is explicitly flagged with '(?' and pointer to sweep JSON, so no false essential inference; corrected exact histogram is published in RESULT.md. Missing scratch/search/sweep files do not affect verifiability of S* since verifier reruns from coordinate list alone in <1s.

originality.rationale: Claim-level comparison shows disjoint hypotheses and conclusions. Candidate quantifiers: exists explicit integer set of size 20 inside fixed 12x12 lattice with universal quantifier over 1140 triples that doubled area >=2 (exact constants D=2, A=1.0, n0=0, n1=0, c2=34, c3=42). Cohen-Pohoata-Zakharov hypothesis is any n points in continuous unit square for sufficiently large n, conclusion is existential small triangle <n^{-8/7-1/2000} via incidence geometry; parameter range is asymptotic large-n, provides no 12x12 integer witness and no D>=2 audit. Prellberg hypothesis is n x n grid, conclusion is 2n points with D>=1 (no det==0); quantifier forbids only one residue class (0) while candidate forbids two (0 and 1), so D>=2 is a qualitative Pick-quantization step; baseline parabola mod 11 has (n0=0,n1=6) confirming non-implication, and parity-pigeonhole (6 even-x values force vertical collinear triple among 20 points) rules out trivial scaling. Friedman/MONJI/Sudermann-Merx hypotheses are continuous unit-square placements with real coordinates and heuristic or certified optima to n~9-35; conclusions are scaled areas with no integrality constraint, so lattice quantization to 0.5*Z and exhaustive integer-determinant verification over 1140 triples is a disjoint search space and audit protocol. Valtr/empty-hole literature hypothesis is general-position planar sets, conclusion counts k-holes; it does not bound min area and H=6 here is a secondary grid-restricted metric. Live negative searches reinforce: arXiv grid AND Heilbronn 0 hits, Heilbronn AND lattice 2 hits both irrelevant (hep-ex Project X false positive), minimal-determinant AND grid 0 hits, unimodular AND no-three-in-line 0 hits, doubled-area 4 hits all irrelevant cosmology/quantum/cloud titles. No retrieved source exhibits the S* coordinates, the (12,20,D>=2) triple, or any minimal-determinant >=2 table for 12x12.

value.rationale: Independently worth finding later as a verifiable lattice-Heilbronn record, not a textbook/parameter/epsilon/enumeration reject. Not textbook: no textbook gives maximal lattice-min-area tables for 12x12 n=20; small-det/record tables are absent. Not parameter substitution: m=11 vs 12 relabeling would preserve D>=1 class, whereas D>=2 eliminates all unimodular pairs (Pick quantization structural step connecting discrete geometry, additive combinatorics, exact verification); impossibility of parity-restricted scaling shown above proves parameters are not interchangeable. Not tiny unmotivated gain: factor-2 doubling of minimal area (0.5->1.0) with 34 det-2 triples as quantified distance to D>=3, plus 5 independent D>=2 sets and new D>=2 configs for (10,12),(10,16),(12,12),(12,16),(12,18) in fallback sweeps, is a motivated quantized jump with explicit gap analysis, not a 1% tweak. Not unexplained enumeration: coordinates plus <1s independent exact verifier, full exact histogram (1140 triples), empty-convex certificate with witness, methodological finding (pure (n0,n1) lexicographic objective finds D>=2 in 3/32 seeds at ~0.5s each where c2/c3-penalized ILS traps at (0,1)), and benchmark/gap table with reuse instructions provide explanation and reuse beyond raw list. Genre-appropriate contribution for exact-combinatorial discrete geometry where explicit checkable configurations are the standard record form; third party can rerun deterministically on laptop. Secondary H=6 and D>=3 openness (min c2=34) give forward research hooks.
